info.name: CV Builder and My CVs
info.description:
README

Import: In Postman choose Import > File and select this collection JSON, then launch Collection Runner on the collection. Run the full collection from top to bottom.

Prerequisites: Start the Spring Boot backend at http://localhost:8080 and make its configured persistence dependencies available, including the database if the active application profile requires one. The current CurrentJobSeekerProvider selects JobSeekerDataStore.DEFAULT_PROFILE_ID (currently profile 1); that profile must be available.

Run order: CV Builder retrieves templates, creates and reads a draft, saves personal details and each section plus section configuration, chooses a template, and finalizes. Its Negative tests folder checks body/field validation, 404, incomplete finalize (422), and page-size capping. My CVs lists and reads the completed CV, renames it, duplicates it, changes template, sets default, downloads the completed CV, and removes the duplicate. Its Negative tests folder repeats the boundary checks and incomplete-finalize test, then removes the incomplete draft.

Results: Runner displays each request's Post-response tests. Successful JSON requests assert expected status, success=true, and response time under 1000 ms. Download CV returns PDF bytes and tests its actual content type. Negative tests assert exact 4xx status, success=false, and no HTTP 500. The collection-level guard fails every HTTP 500. The page-size assertion assumes the default halokazi.cv.max-page-size=50.

Code-matched limitations: List accepts only page and size; there is no status filter or sort parameter. The requested profileId=1 collection variable is included for reference, but the controller has no profileId query parameter; the current profile provider resolves the profile internally. Another jobseeker's CV cannot be selected because this API has no authentication/profile selector. An invalid sort field cannot be sent because no sort parameter exists. Template codes are selected from Get Templates (the DTO validation allows CLASSIC, MODERN, PROFESSIONAL, MINIMAL, GRADUATE). Mutation requests send the numeric returned data.version in If-Match. Date values use YYYY-MM-DD.

exec: pm.test('Collection guard: no response is HTTP 500', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'Unexpected server error').to.not.eql(500); });
